verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an object-storage capability that Workers developers can use to persist user uploads. R2 appears only incidentally, as an event type ('an R2 bucket being created') and as an API surface reachable via MCP. Bindings to 'storage' are framed as external services, KV/D1 are key-value and SQL stores rather than object storage, and Cloudflare Images is an image-specific media pipeline, so it is adjacent rather than general object storage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist user-generated uploads using built-in object storage
